settings.hotkeyHint: Select text in any app and press the hotkey to read it aloud. Press again to pause; press with new text to restart. Windows reads the selection with UI Automation and does not use the clipboard. Linux reads only the primary selection (wl-paste --primary or xclip -selection primary) and does not use the clipboard. The shortcut stores the physical key (Alt+Shift+Digit7, Super+Slash), not the printed character.
